source.note: Files here churn because a CI lint requires the edit, so no refactor can retire their hotspot flag. Both `lint` and `reason` are REQUIRED and non-empty: `lint` names the enforcing check, `reason` says why that check forces a row edit. An entry stating no enforcing lint is rejected by churn-hotspots.sh with exit 3, so exemption cannot be claimed on assertion alone. Exempt files are still scored and still reported — on the detector's `exempt (catalog)` line and in `exemptions[]` — they are simply absent from `hotspots[]`, so /wrap raises no needs-decision item for them. Mechanism: .claude/reference/churn-hotspots.md.

.claude/scripts/README.md.reason: The scripts catalog index. Lint rules 3 and 5 require the index to link every doc under .claude/scripts/docs/ exactly once and to hold no per-script rows itself, so adding or renaming a category doc forces an index edit and CI fails without it. Issue #898 split the per-script rows out of this file; what remains is a lint-enforced index whose residual churn is structural, not a refactor signal.

.claude/scripts/docs/tests.md.reason: The tests category doc. Lint rule 1 enforces a bijection between .claude/scripts/tests/*.test.sh and the catalog rows, so every test suite added or renamed requires exactly one row edit here or CI fails. Also a recurring merge-conflict surface for concurrent PRs (PR #1543, 2026-09-01).
